mapper.insert: INSERT INTO class_session ( schedule_id, term, class_code, course_code, course_name, teacher_no, teacher_name, week_no, weekday, period_start, period_end, session_date, start_time, end_time, location, status, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{scheduleId}, #{term}, #{classCode}, #{courseCode}, #{courseName}, #{teacherNo}, #{teacherName}, #{weekNo}, #{weekday}, #{periodStart}, #{periodEnd}, #{sessionDate}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{location}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} ) ON CONFLICT (schedule_id, week_no) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT id, schedule_id AS scheduleId, term, class_code AS classCode, course_code AS courseCode, course_name AS courseName, teacher_no AS teacherNo, teacher_name AS teacherName, week_no AS weekNo, weekday, period_start AS periodStart, period_end AS periodEnd, session_date AS sessionDate, start_time AS startTime, end_time AS endTime, location, status, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM class_session WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE class_session SET session_date = #{sessionDate}, start_time = #{startTime}, end_time = #{endTime}, location = COALESCE(#{location}, location), status = 'RESCHEDULED', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
